method: Read both code sites at each finding's exact commit and the source changes and intent in git show; judge the proposed replacement, not merely vocabulary overlap. No human review or execution of upstream tests.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: timedOut orchestrates request lifecycle timeouts and returns cleanup; addTimeout is its nested timer-creation helper capturing cancelers, not an interchangeable request handler.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: addTimeout creates and registers a timer; its nested cancel closure clears that specific timer. Calling the child instead would remove timer creation and requires unavailable closure state.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: cancel marks an event handled and clears a timeout; timeoutHandler schedules destruction of an unhandled request. The bug fix deliberately separates cancellation from firing.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: timeoutHandler must report an unhandled timeout; cancel does the opposite and is private to addTimeout. Replacing firing with cancellation would suppress the intended error.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: BoolParamType is the class defining boolean states, conversion and error handling; convert is already its own method and cannot replace the class that supplies that state and interface.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: BoolParamType.convert normalizes a value through str_to_bool and raises parameter-aware errors; calling the containing class constructs an object rather than converting the value.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: MissingParameter is an exception class with initialization and formatting behavior; its format_message method is part of that class, not a replacement exception implementation.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: MissingParameter.format_message produces text from exception state; invoking MissingParameter instead produces another exception object. The commit changes a type annotation, not duplicated behavior.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: ZshComplete supplies a Zsh-specific completion protocol and escaping; FishComplete.get_completion_args parses Fish-specific partial-word conventions and cannot replace an entire Zsh class.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: ZshComplete.format_completion escapes colons and serializes one item; example list_users filters demo users into CompletionItem objects. Input, output and purpose differ.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: _get_progress_information_message formats count/time/percentage strings; _is_last_item returns a boolean. The commit fixes timing aggregation for skipped modules, not duplicated progress detection.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: Session is the collection-root class with lifecycle and state; perform_collect is already a contained instance method. Replacing the class with its method destroys the session interface.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: Session.perform_collect expands initial arguments into collected items using session state; calling Session constructs a collection root and does not perform this operation.
